name: Prosa-PT · rubricas filtradas
summary: Qualidade de respostas a conversas reais em português, com histórico e rubricas binárias.

protocol.selection: public frozen question_excluded and checklist_filtered_indices; never recomputed
protocol.candidate_history: original fixed conversation_input; generate only the final assistant response
protocol.candidate_sampling: explicit model/mode profile, including its output limit; no reasoning_effort
protocol.judge_prompt: native RRD F.3; all original rubrics per included question; final content only
protocol.failure_policy: native: retry failed calls up to three attempts; parse the first returned judgment once; score valid YES/NO selected rubrics and report missing-verdict coverage; require all 1000 generations and judgments for all 981 included conversations
